title: space.area_link
description: A generic many-to-many relation between two space areas (ward <-> dma <-> service_area <-> place). Wards and DMAs are different delimitations, so membership is an overlap, not a single parent. overlap_fraction = share of `from` that falls inside `to`. Used for area-only records and area->area rollups; point-anchored facts stamp their area refs directly at ingest instead. PLATFORM geography (space.*).

from_ref.description: The contained/child area id (e.g. a space.ward).

to_ref.description: The containing/parent area id (e.g. a space.dma).
